heading: Meet the (fictional) team.
intro: Every profile below is an illustrative, fictional persona created for this concept demo — not a real clinician. No real names, photos, registration numbers, or board certifications are used.

doctors.name: Dr. Ananya Rao
doctors.bio: A fictional profile illustrating a senior cardiology consultant focused on preventive screening and structured post-procedure follow-up.

doctors.name: Dr. Marcus Chen
doctors.bio: A fictional profile illustrating an orthopedic consultant who favors conservative treatment paths before recommending surgery.

doctors.name: Dr. Priya Nair
doctors.bio: A fictional profile illustrating a neurology consultant who emphasizes structured assessment before imaging.

doctors.name: Dr. Daniel Osei
doctors.bio: A fictional profile illustrating a pediatrician known for explaining every step directly to younger patients.

doctors.name: Dr. Fatima Al-Sayed
doctors.bio: A fictional profile illustrating a maternity consultant who stays assigned to a patient's case across the full pregnancy where possible.

doctors.name: Dr. Rohan Mehta
doctors.bio: A fictional profile illustrating an emergency-medicine lead focused on fast, accurate handoffs to specialty teams.

doctors.name: Dr. Lucia Fernandes
